name: Balanced Dollar
oneLiner: bnUSD is Balanced's cross-chain decentralized dollar backed by crypto loan collateral and USDC or USDT held in its Stability Fund.
collateral: SODAX cross-chain money-market borrower collateral backing all facilitator-minted bnUSD; measured 2026-07-30 at Sonic block 76778944: ~39.8% sodahyTB (HiYield Treasury Bill Vault), ~23.7% sodaUSDC, ~7.2% sodaBTC, ~6.9% sodaBNB, ~3.7% each sodaAVAX and sodaSUI, ~3.4% sodasftUSD, ~2.3% sodaETH, ~2.0% sodaUSDT, and a long tail of other SODAX-wrapped crypto collateral. Stability Fund approved-stablecoin 1:1 swaps mint through the same facilitator, so those stablecoin deposits are part of the measured borrower-collateral base
pegMechanism: Users borrow bnUSD against eligible crypto collateral through Balanced's cross-chain money market, while the Stability Fund mints or burns bnUSD 1:1 against USDC and USDT to support the peg

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Balanced describes bnUSD as a crypto-backed stablecoin minted through collateralized positions and its Stability Fund. This is a collateralized-debt-position stabilization path, so the CDP archetype is the supported classification; the current collateral allocation remains separately bounded by the reserve review.

oracleRisk.summary: bnUSD loan collateral is priced on ICON through Balanced Oracle v1.3.0 (cx133c...), which Loans calls via getLastPriceInUSD. At ICON block 116171048 the debt-bearing inventory is dominated by sICX (~96.3%), which uses Band ICX/USD times the staking sICX rate under a 30-minute global staleness gate; other Band-priced collaterals match Band feeds directly, while SOL/XLM/JITOSOL use long-threshold manual external prices.

branchApplicability.reviewer: Grok Safety Score V9 wave-8 controls research
branchApplicability.rationale: ICON Balanced Loans (cx66d4..., v1.3.0) exposes per-collateral debt, liquidation ratio, locking ratio, and price lookups. At block 116171048 getTotalCollateralDebt showed twelve debt-bearing collateral markets with different oracle paths (Band vs manual external) and two liquidation-ratio settings (117.65% vs 125%). Market-specific oracle and liquidation rows are therefore required. Registered zero-debt collaterals AFSUI/HASUI/VSUI/weETH/wstETH/tBTC appear in getCollateralTokens but are omitted as inactive markets at the pinned observation.

branches.label: Balanced Loans sICX (Band ICX + staking rate)
branches.summary: ICON Balanced Loans collateral market for sICX priced through Balanced Oracle (Band Protocol path) with per-symbol liquidation ratio 117.65% and permissionless liquidate(); residual bad debt is cancellable by burning bnUSD.

feeds.provider: Band Protocol ICX/USD via Balanced Oracle + Balanced Staking sICX/ICX rate
feeds.path: ICON Band Oracle get_reference_data(ICX,USD) * Staked ICX Manager getTodayRate -> Balanced Oracle getLastPriceInUSD(sICX) -> Loans TokenUtils.getPriceInUSD

branches.fallbackBehavior: sICX has no secondary oracle failover. BalancedOracleImpl prices sICX as Staking.getTodayRate * Band ICX/USD. getPrice rejects updates older than the global last-update threshold (1,800 seconds / 30 minutes at the pinned block). Loans liquidations call getLastPriceInUSD and inherit that staleness gate.

collateralParameters.note: On-chain getLiquidationRatio=117.65% and getLockingRatio=150% (implies max LTV 66.6667%) at ICON block 116171048.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Balanced Loans liquidate(owner, amount, collateralSymbol) is permissionless when position standing is LIQUIDATE. The liquidator burns bnUSD and receives discounted collateral after liquidator and DAOfund fee slices configured per symbol.
branches.backstop: First-line backstop is open-market liquidators who burn bnUSD for discounted collateral. There is no Stability-Pool-style dedicated bnUSD backstop pool on the Loans SCORE. Residual debt after collateral is exhausted is recorded as per-collateral bad debt (DebtDB) and can later be cancelled by burning bnUSD via cancelBadDebt.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: Loans operations including liquidate and borrow are gated by checkStatus()/loansOn(). Undercollateralized remainder after full collateral liquidation is written to bad debt rather than socialized across other positions; cancelBadDebt burns bnUSD to reduce that balance. No separate global shutdown cascade was observed in the Loans v1.3.0 interface beyond status gating and bad-debt accounting.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At ICON block 115645618, the canonical bnUSD SCORE was active and registered Balanced Governance as its owner. The exact v1.1.2 deployed archive exposes govTransfer, which only Governance may use to move bnUSD from an arbitrary source address, and calls checkStatus before ordinary transfers. The exact v1.0.3 Governance archive has owner-only control paths, and its active owner is a single EOA. This is a direct canonical holder-control surface; upstream reserve exposure remains separate.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: TERRA-III Safety Score V9 access review

mintAuthority.summary: bnUSD minting is limited on ICON to the registered Balanced Loans and Peg Stability SCOREs, subject to the token debt ceiling; the current owner of the Governance SCORE is a single EOA that can raise that ceiling and upgrade mint-critical SCORE logic.

controls.label: Balanced Loans SCORE
controls.capDescription: At ICON block 115645618, the bnUSD SCORE debt ceiling was 8,000,000 bnUSD; only the registered Loans or Peg Stability SCORE may call mintTo, while Governance can raise the ceiling.
controls.evidence: The active bnUSD SCORE returned this registered Loans address. Its exact v1.1.2 deployed archive permits mintTo only from getLoans() or getStabilityFund(), and its mint implementation rejects supply above the configured debt ceiling.

controls.label: Balanced Peg Stability SCORE
controls.capDescription: At ICON block 115645618, the bnUSD SCORE debt ceiling was 8,000,000 bnUSD; only the registered Loans or Peg Stability SCORE may call mintTo, while Governance can raise the ceiling.
controls.evidence: The active bnUSD SCORE returned this registered Peg Stability address. Its exact v1.1.2 deployed archive permits mintTo only from getLoans() or getStabilityFund(), and its mint implementation rejects supply above the configured debt ceiling.

controls.label: Balanced Governance owner
controls.capDescription: The Governance SCORE owns bnUSD and its single current EOA owner can execute Governance calls that raise the debt ceiling or deploy replacement mint-critical SCORE code without an on-chain vote delay.
controls.evidence: At block 115645618, the active Governance SCORE owner was this hx account and the bnUSD SCORE owner was the Governance SCORE. The exact v1.0.3 deployed archive gates execute() and deployTo() to that SCORE owner, allowing it to change bnUSD's debt ceiling or mint-critical SCORE code.

review.evidence: The historical documentation describes a collateralized bnUSD CDP. At ICON block 115645618, the tracked canonical bnUSD SCORE was active (v1.1.2), had an 8,000,000 bnUSD debt ceiling, and registered the Loans and Peg Stability SCOREs as its only direct minters. The exact deployed v1.1.2 archive enforces those checks. The SCORE is owned by Balanced Governance, whose current owner is the single hx account above; the exact deployed v1.0.3 Governance archive exposes owner-only execute() and deployTo() paths. This establishes a scoreable concentrated-admin mint and upgrade authority rather than the earlier no-RPC uncertainty.
review.reviewer: TERRA-III Safety Score V9 control review

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: bnUSD is minted on ICON (canonical SCORE cx88fd7df7ddff82f7cc735c871dc519838cb235bb, ~99% of supply) and every tracked off-ICON deployment is a burn-mint representation settled through Balanced's own xCall messaging: on Base, Avalanche, Arbitrum, BSC, and the newly verified Optimism deployment (0xdccd213951d8214fbaca720728474e2cef9d247b) only the chain's xCall contract can invoke handleCallMessage to mint, per the verified BalancedDollar source; on Injective the CW20 bnUSD minter is the cw_xcall contract. Token UUPS ownership and xCallManager ownership sit with the Balanced ops EOA 0x9920c455 (EVM) / inj106a2du (Injective). All rows re-verified on-chain 2026-07-20. DefiLlama's ICON/Archway/Havah raw chain labels (~98.9% of supply) have no Pharos chain mapping and remain an accepted unmatched-label pool routed to the policy maintainer.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-8 (lead usdy-ondo-finance)

routes.reviewNote: Verified on-chain 2026-07-20 (base block 48861818): EIP-1967 proxy (implementation 0x806d35736c4d7a144db8fdb14cba9633c4284ee6, verified BalancedDollar source on the Base deployment) whose iconBnUSD() returns 0x1.icon/cx88fd7df7ddff82f7cc735c871dc519838cb235bb (the canonical ICON bnUSD SCORE). notices.title: Primary issuance lives on ICON, not yet a Pharos-supported chain
notices.message: bnUSD is minted on ICON (canonical contract cx88fd7df7ddff82f7cc735c871dc519838cb235bb) where ~95% of supply currently sits. Balanced uses its xCall infrastructure to extend the same supply to other chains, so the EVM/Injective contracts tracked here represent cross-chain burn-mint representations of the ICON-issued supply. Additional active deployments on Archway and Havah (also not Pharos-supported) are visible in DefiLlama but excluded from contracts[] until those chains are wired into Pharos; the Optimism deployment was verified and added 2026-07-20.

notices.title: Balanced v1 transition and v2 launch
notices.message: Balanced's current documentation says v2 launched on April 7, 2026 and the original v1 app is no longer supported. The deployments tracked here are the historical v1 ICON-Hub bnUSD entry; current v2 issuance, reserves, and authority are not asserted until a verified active contract inventory is available.

reserveReview.rationale: Fresh write-time re-measurement 2026-07-30 replacing the 2026-07-28 unknown-weights envelope. MEASUREMENT at Sonic block 76778944 (2026-07-30T21:18:20Z, https://rpc.soniclabs.com): total bnUSD supply = facilitator bucket currentBorrowed = 1,408,507.20 bnUSD (cap 2,500,000; cross-check variableDebtToken 0x9d6658bfdf512bc08ede9ef75d64a9e5d4f321de totalSupply = 1,409,413.59, delta 0.06%). Total backing = sum of all 82 bnUSD borrowers' aToken collateral across 24 nonzero SODAX money-market reserves (SODAX backend API borrowers/positions, indexed ~1.8k blocks behind the pin), each reserve priced with the pool's own Aave oracle getAssetPrice at the pinned block = $2,918,934.98, giving collateralizationRatio 2.072361. Market-price cross-check (DefiLlama/CoinGecko majors) agrees with oracle prices within 0.1% on covered assets; hyTB and SODA have no market-price coverage and rely on the pool oracle. On-chain spot-check: whale 0x73135d19c488ea5b002e0e07135d992ff7e6f070 hyTB aToken balanceOf at the pin = 1,053,059.9039543339, exactly matching the API position read; that single account holds the entire sodahyTB slice (39.76% of backing), so concentration risk is dominated by one tokenized T-bill position. Composition: sodahyTB $1,160,456 (39.76%), sodaUSDC $692,000 (23.71%), sodaBTC $209,393 (7.17%), sodaBNB $201,630 (6.91%), sodaAVAX $108,681 (3.72%), sodaSUI $103,945 (3.56%), sodasftUSD $99,893 (3.42%), sodaETH $67,942 (2.33%), sodaUSDT $59,746 (2.05%), sodaWEETH $51,961 (1.78%), sodaSODA $50,182 (1.72%), sodaHYPE $33,661 (1.15%), sodaSOL $28,196 (0.97%), sodaWSTETH $23,433 (0.80%), tail $27,772 (0.95%). hyTB identified as HiYield Treasury Bill Vault (SnowTrace token 0x8475509d391e6ee5A8b7133221CE17019D307B3E; Balanced BIPs 53/56/59/60). Assurance scope: the SODAX audits index lists 8 reports (Sui, Solana, Soroban, Relay, Collaborative 2025-08, Near, Stacks, LST/Leverage vault), none scoped to the hub EVM money-market Pool. The Stability Fund's approved-stablecoin 1:1 swaps mint through the same facilitator, so its stablecoin holdings are captured inside the borrower-collateral base rather than being an additive unmeasured layer.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: 100% of measured bnUSD backing sits as borrower aToken collateral inside the SODAX money-market Pool on the Sonic hub: pooled (omnibus) smart-contract custody with no legal segregation or bankruptcy estate, and Aave-style pool design permits supplied assets to be lent out. Upstream custody layers (the HiYield T-bill vault's off-chain custodian, Circle/Tether issuance, and SODAX spoke-chain asset managers holding underlying tokens) remain as dependency risk carried on the individual reserve slices rather than as unidentified custody.
